title: Decouple tool descriptions from AGENTS
description: Removes the duplicated tool API table from AGENTS.md and makes OpenCode tool schema the source of truth for tool descriptions and arguments.
changes: Replace the explicit true-execution tool table with schema-first tool usage principles.
Clarify that AGENTS.md owns cross-tool strategy and behavior boundaries, not individual tool API documentation.
Keep high-level workflow rules that must reference specific tools, such as experiment execution and artifact verification.
Shorten the environment section so it points to current OpenCode tool schema instead of maintaining a duplicate tool list.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if removing the tool table reduces tool selection quality.
